name: Wingshift
summary:
Move your hands. Transform your ship. Change the fight.

WINGSHIFT places an experimental interceptor between your controllers. Move both hands to steer, bring them together to fold the wings, and tilt them to bank through the machinery. Each controller aims its own wing-mounted cannon. Keep moving while you fight two targets at once.

Fly five connected missions across an orbital harbour, an automated foundry, a fractured moon, a fleet graveyard and a solar megastructure. Ada Voss guides your flight as you
